tour.welcome.title: Welcome to BotHub! 👋
tour.welcome.text: This short tour shows you the most important parts of the dashboard, step by step. Arrow keys move on, Esc ends it.
tour.bots.title: Your bots
tour.bots.text: All your bots are here; one click switches between them. The selected bot decides what every page shows. "+ Add bot" adds a new one.
tour.search.title: Quick search
tour.search.text: Type to filter the navigation and find pages, modules and settings fast.
tour.nav.title: Navigation
tour.nav.text: Everything about your bot: overview, settings, servers, logs, modules, commands and plugins.
tour.modules.title: Modules
tour.modules.text: All modules of the bot, sorted by category. The switch on a card turns a whole module on or off; "Edit" opens it. Let’s go into one.
tour.module_head.title: A module page
tour.module_head.text: This is the Economy module. The big switch at the top turns it on or off for this bot.
tour.module_settings.title: Module settings
tour.module_settings.text: Every module has its settings right here: for Economy the currencies, daily bonus, bank interest, lottery and the shop with its items. Changes show up in the save bar at the bottom.
tour.module_commands.title: Its commands
tour.module_commands.text: The commands of the module, each with its own switch. The gear opens the command.
tour.plugins.title: Plugins
tour.plugins.text: Plugins from the App Store add more commands and features. Switch them on per bot here; their page shows settings and commands.
tour.settings.title: Your settings
tour.settings.text: The settings from the user menu: general (language, design), account, security with password and 2FA, and your API / Secrets.
tour.secrets.title: API / Secrets
tour.secrets.text: Keys and addresses for plugins (e.g. OpenAI, Plex, Forge) go here. They belong to you only, a bot uses the keys of its owner, and a plugin never sees them: switch a secret on for the plugin that may use it.
tour.demo_perms.title: Roles and rights per command
tour.demo_perms.text: The gear opens the settings of a command: which roles may use it, which are banned and in which channels it is blocked.
tour.lang.title: Language
tour.lang.text: The globe sets your own dashboard language; it applies to you only.
tour.user.title: Your menu
tour.user.text: Down here: your settings (profile, password, 2FA, API / Secrets), the App Store with plugins, the admin area and log out.
tour.again.title: Tour again
tour.again.text: This button starts the tour again whenever you like.
tour.done.title: Let's go! 🚀
tour.done.text: That was it. Add your first bot with "+ Add bot" or explore the modules. Have fun with BotHub!
